verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a Library that imports thousands of papers, including PDFs and Zotero, BibTeX and RIS files, into a searchable, AI-powered workspace where users can search and find gaps in their collection. It does not explicitly say the research agent or Deep Search runs over the uploaded corpus. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent/synthesis features operate over user-uploaded PDFs, details on full-text analysis of uploaded files, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: Turn your library into a research engine. Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS
The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.
